heading: Developing
content:
```bash
quasar dev -m ssr

# ..or the longer form:
quasar dev --mode ssr
```

heading: Building for production
content:
```bash
quasar build -m ssr

# ..or the longer form:
quasar build --mode ssr
```

If you want a production build with debugging enabled:

```bash
quasar build -m ssr -d

# ..or the longer form
quasar build -m ssr --debug
```
